reviewer: runtime agent, independent of interface author

checks.basis: Every read obtains the current source through read_program and admits that source on the original request check; no authorization state is cached.
The second SQLite query reads the entire current blob, report, source revision and SHA; source revision must match the first query, and both byte limits remain 64 MiB.
Every read validates current report program revision and implementation; current stored SHA and content-derived artifact ID are checked after all original integrity charges.
Only a native immutable _VerifiedBytes tuple published through the module-owned weak-key map is available through the read-only service property; six ordinary callback assignment variants refuse.

A cache hit requires exact native project/artifact/data/digest fields and complete bytes equality. This establishes reuse of the earlier SHA result for identical bytes; changed bytes take the complete original hash route.
Both hash misses and full-byte hits retain each original 64 KiB integrity tick and the original slice tick. Author tests independently replayed compare entire callback traces and charges.
Exactly one proof per live service is retained, bounded by the unchanged 64 MiB artifact limit. There is no request-history or authority cache.
Close first fences the store then clears under the same cache lock; the publisher checks closed under that lock. Actual delayed publication after completed close is tested.
Uncaught callback AttributeError keeps its original object identity; failed publication retains original durable rollback behavior.
One autocommit SQLite connection is checked out exclusively under a native lock; overlapping/nested requests use inherited fresh connections. No callback or transaction is held under that lock.
The reused connection has a fixed 8 MiB SQLite cache and the inherited timeout/synchronous settings; unfinished explicit transactions roll back when a context exits.
Actual interleaved services observe committed updates; reopened services do not receive a cached authority grant. Concurrent request tests and deferred close tests pass.
Only explicit TorqueAgentService/TorqueProgramStore select the optimization; inherited predecessor service/store schema behavior remains tested.

limits: Review covers ordinary native callback-visible service proof ownership and complete current durable reads; it is not a Python-process sandbox claim.
